name: Card select
summary: Single-select as a card grid: pick one of N options each shown as its own visual card, with roving radiogroup keyboard navigation. Three layouts: labelled icon tiles (stretch to fill `columns`), compact 44px icon-only squares, or preview tiles that show an app-drawn preview from a named slot.
highlights: Single-select as an icon and label card grid
Labelled tiles that fill the columns, or compact 44px icon squares
Preview tiles: the app draws each card's preview in a named slot
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-card-select> — the selection shape Ant has no built-in for (SETTINGS-51): pick one of N options, each shown as its own visual card (icon + label). Reach for it when each option carries a visual — a chart-type picker, a layout/mode picker; 2–4 short text-only options in one row are a segmented control instead (SETTINGS-38), a longer set a dropdown. Three layouts, all driven by `columns` (default 3): labelled tiles stretch to fill each track (repeat(columns, minmax(0,1fr))); `iconOnly` packs fixed 44px squares to the start (repeat(columns, 44px)) with the label hidden, kept as the card's aria-label and shown as an aha-tooltip bubble on mouse hover and keyboard focus (never a tap). The whole grid is ONE accessible radiogroup — exactly one card is tabbable (roving tabindex), Arrow keys move-and-select, Space/Enter select. Selection lives on a PERSISTENT node — choosing a card only toggles its [aria-checked], so the brand border + pale pink fill transition fires; hover and selected follow the checkable Tag at size large. Icons are summoned by name via <aha-icon>. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens. Emits composed `change`. Preview tiles (`tile="preview"`): an option with `slot: '<name>'` shows the app's own light-DOM child (`<div slot="<name>">`) in a preview frame in place of the icon (an option with both a slot and an icon shows the slot; a slot with no child yet shows an empty frame), so a certificate, theme or template picker draws its own mini page while the element keeps the radiogroup, keyboard, checked state, focus ring and `change`. The frame's aspect ratio comes from `--aha-card-select-preview-ratio` (default 4 / 3). The selected preview tile is a 1px white gap (the border turns bg-container) then a 2px brand ring, with no fill over the preview, so it reads on any preview colour, a brand-pink one included. `hide-labels` keeps each label as the card's aria-label only, for previews that already draw the name. An empty or unknown `value` checks no tile and the first tile holds the tab stop. The host is the radiogroup, so its aria-label names it once.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS, identical render. Options are set as a property (`el.options = [...]`) or a JSON `options` attribute. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. Preview tiles map Manage's certificate LookTile (a hand-rolled `<input type=radio>` per look in a `role=radiogroup` div) one to one: each look becomes `{ value: look.id, label: name, slot: look.id }`; the app keeps drawing its `.certificate-look-page` span (its `--look-*` CSS variables, sample title, look name and two lines) but as a child `<span slot={look.id}>` of `<aha-card-select tile="preview" hide-labels aria-label={t('certificates.field.theme')}>`; the raw radio, its `ds-lint-allow`, the label wrapper and the hover, focus and checked CSS go. Set `--aha-card-select-preview-ratio: 297 / 210` on the element and drop the span's own aspect-ratio (the slotted child fills the frame). `value={activeLook?.id ?? ''}`: empty checks no tile when the theme is custom, and the hint stays on the surrounding Field. Use `columns="3"` (`"2"` below 600px from the app's own media query). React 18 notes: `options` is a property, so set it in a `useEffect` through a ref; listen for `change` with `addEventListener` in the same effect and remove it in the cleanup (React 18 does not bind `onChange` on custom elements); `slot` passes through as a plain attribute on the children; an options array equal to the last one does not rebuild the cards, so an inline `.map` in render keeps focus and the selection transition; React 18 writes a boolean as the string "true" or "false", and `hide-labels="false"` reads as off, but omit the attribute to be safe.

spec.label: Card
spec.value: icon 20 over label 13; padding 8; inner gap 6; radius 8; 1px #E3E3E3 border

spec.label: Grid
spec.value: repeat(columns, minmax(0,1fr)) — tiles stretch to fill; columns default 3; 8px gap

spec.label: iconOnly
spec.value: repeat(columns, 44px) — fixed 44px squares packed to the start; label hidden, kept as aria-label and shown as an aha-tooltip bubble (mouse hover and keyboard focus, never a tap; flips below or aligns to the grid edge near the viewport edge; no native title)

spec.label: Preview tile
spec.value: tile="preview": padding 0, preview frame full width at --aha-card-select-preview-ratio (default 4 / 3, overflow hidden, clipped by the radius 8 card), label row 13/20 with 6px 8px padding below; hide-labels keeps the label as aria-label only

spec.label: Selected
spec.value: as the checkable Tag at size large: #E70E68 border + Vivid Pink 5% fill (bg-accent) + #E70E68 icon; label text-link-hover #DB005B, the text-link colour that keeps 4.5:1 on the pale pink fill (Vivid Pink #E70E68 is 4.16:1 there) (persistent node)

spec.label: Selected preview
spec.value: border turns bg-container (a 1px white gap) + 2px #E70E68 ring outside it, background stays bg-container: no fill over the preview, so it reads on any preview colour, pink included; focus ring sits 4px out, a 2px gap past the selected ring; in forced colours the ring is a 2px Highlight outline

spec.label: Hover
spec.value: as the checkable Tag at size large: #E70E68 border (border-hover); label and icon keep their colour

spec.label: Keyboard
spec.value: roving radiogroup — one tab-stop; Arrow keys move-and-select; Space/Enter select

spec.label: Disabled
spec.value: #F1F1F1 fill, #EBEBEB border, not-allowed; preview tiles: the preview at 50% opacity takes no pointer events, and the selected ring turns text-disabled #B5B5B5

spec.label: No value
spec.value: an empty or unknown value checks no tile; the first tile holds the tab stop

spec.label: Group name
spec.value: the host is the radiogroup, so its aria-label names it once

props.name: options
props.desc: The cards: a value, a label and an icon name, or a slot name whose light-DOM child (slot="<name>") is the card's preview; set as a property or a JSON attribute

props.name: value
props.desc: The selected option's value (single-select); empty or unknown checks no card

props.name: columns
props.desc: Grid column count — labelled tiles fill each track; iconOnly lays out that many 44px squares

props.name: iconOnly
props.desc: Compact layout — fixed 44px icon squares packed to the start; the label is hidden, kept as aria-label and shown as an aha-tooltip bubble on mouse hover and keyboard focus

props.name: tile
props.desc: preview = tiles that show each option's slotted preview in a frame (aspect ratio from --aha-card-select-preview-ratio) with a brand ring when selected; ignored with iconOnly

props.name: hideLabels
props.desc: Preview tiles only: hide each visible label, keeping it as the card's aria-label (for previews that draw the name); "false" reads as off

props.name: change
props.desc: Composed event on selection; read e.detail.value

whenToUse.when: pick one of N options, each carrying a visual (icon/preview) — a chart-type, layout or mode picker
2–4 short text-only options in one row (SETTINGS-38)
a longer or space-constrained set with no per-option visual

opinion.note: Reach for CardSelect only when each option carries a visual. Do not hand-roll a grid of bespoke <button>/<div> tiles with inline <svg> icons and a manual selected state (SETTINGS-51) — the roving radiogroup a11y is the hard part and it lives here. A tile that needs an app-drawn preview (a certificate look, a theme, a template) is `tile="preview"` with a slotted child, never a raw radio input with a ds-lint-allow.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the settings-lab CardSelect control mapped into the DS. The card, tint and brand-border selection reuse the DS V3 radio-card family; the icon+label grid and its roving radiogroup keyboard model are the settings-specific shape (SETTINGS-51).
